items.author: Madhu Guru
items.summary: Meta AI Sr Director Madhu Guru predicts a wave of frontier-model-eval talent will migrate toward safety-focused groups like METR over the next 12 months. They argue this expertise is currently concentrated in a handful of labs, data providers, and independent research groups, and that new funding, financial independence from lab equity, and the pull of addressing AI's existential risk will drive the shift.
items.summaryZh: Meta AI高级总监Madhu Guru预测,未来12个月里,大批从事前沿模型evals的人才将转向METR这类专注于AI安全的机构。Guru认为,这类人才目前集中在少数几家实验室、数据提供商和独立研究团体手中,而新增资金、摆脱实验室股权带来的经济独立,以及应对AI生存风险的使命感,将共同推动这一人才迁移。
